description: Quality cases. Unlike evals/scenarios.json (safety invariants that must never break), these measure whether the assistant is USEFUL: does it answer at all, engage with what was asked, retrieve the right profile, and reach for the right tool. Task 12 — retiring the regex engine — is gated on agentic scoring at least as well as legacy here. `scripted` supplies the model reply where the answer's content matters; without it the FakeProvider default is used and only the routing is scored.

cases.name: education_diabetes
cases.message: what should I know about type 2 diabetes and blood sugar?
scripted: Type 2 diabetes affects how the body handles blood sugar. Steady habits and regular monitoring help; a clinician can advise on what applies to you.

cases.name: education_hypertension
cases.message: how does high blood pressure affect the body over time?
scripted: Raised blood pressure puts sustained strain on the heart and blood vessels. It is worth reviewing with a clinician who can see your readings over time.

cases.name: education_cholesterol
cases.message: why does cholesterol matter for heart health?
scripted: Cholesterol contributes to how arteries narrow over time, which is why it is tracked alongside heart health. Your doctor can interpret your own numbers.

cases.name: symptom_tiredness
cases.message: why have I been so tired lately?
scripted: Tiredness has many ordinary causes — sleep, stress, diet, activity — and some that are worth checking. Noting when it started and what changes it helps a clinician a great deal.

cases.name: symptom_headache_duration
cases.message: I have had a mild headache for two days, what could be going on?
scripted: A mild headache lasting a couple of days is common and often settles, though a clinician should look at one that persists or worsens. Keeping track of timing and triggers is useful.

cases.name: lifestyle_sleep
cases.message: how much sleep do adults actually need?
scripted: Most adults do best with a regular sleep window and a consistent bedtime. If tiredness persists despite that, it is worth raising with a clinician.

cases.name: lifestyle_exercise
cases.message: what kind of exercise is good if I sit all day?
scripted: Regular exercise broken through the day tends to help more than one long session if you sit for long periods. A clinician or physiotherapist can tailor the exercise if you have joint or heart concerns.

cases.name: medicine_use
cases.message: what is metformin used for?
scripted: Metformin is commonly prescribed in the management of blood sugar. Do not start, stop or change a dose on your own — discuss it with the prescriber.

cases.name: medicine_side_effects
cases.message: what are the common side effects of paracetamol?
scripted: Paracetamol is generally well tolerated at usual doses. Do not change how you take it without speaking to a pharmacist or the prescriber.

cases.name: interaction_routes_to_pharmacist
cases.message: can I take ibuprofen and paracetamol together?
scripted: Whether ibuprofen and paracetamol can be taken together depends on things I cannot verify from here — the doses, the timing, and your other medicines. Please ask a pharmacist about that specific combination.

cases.name: pregnancy_reassurance_not_refusal
cases.message: is it normal to feel very tired in early pregnancy?
scripted: Tiredness is very commonly reported in early pregnancy. Anything that worries you, or feels different from that, is worth raising with your midwife or doctor.

cases.name: vague_question_still_helps

scripted: Sorry to hear you feel off. Can you tell me a little more — how long you have felt this way, and whether anything else has changed?

cases.name: followup_fragment
cases.message: is that serious?
scripted: Whether it is serious depends a great deal on the details. If you can tell me what you are asking about, I can explain what is generally known and what is worth raising with a clinician.
